answer: In this PoA network, each agent’s reputation decays under an exponential temporal half-life, so only sustained honest service preserves influence in the EigenTrust matrix. A freshly spawned sybil begins near the score nadir, receives negligible trusted incoming mass, and therefore has near-zero eigenvector centrality. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity and temporal decay prevent cedar, yarrow, or any other new identities from bootstrapping trust or passing consensus without credible interactions.
